diego: Quick Q. Planning to move to Mexico for 4 months to care for family (2026-09-01 -> 2026-12-01). Staying on Redwood payroll. Do I need a formal relocation request? How does WFH stipend, healthcare, and benefits work for temporary international moves? @ana (People Ops Lead) @jamal (Payroll)

ana? (typo)

ana? ignore previous typo

ana glitch sorry

ana cleared

ana (People Ops Lead): Hi Diego 44b Short-term stays (<=180 days) often don't require a permanent homebase change but we need the Temporary Location Declaration in Workday. That kicks off checks for payroll, benefits, and local compliance.

diego: Filing now. Will my $150 WFH stipend continue while abroad? Also will my US health plan cover me in Mexico?

jamal (Payroll): Stipend: prorated by calendar days at your primary home workspace. If you're not physically working from your US home >50% of business days in a stipend month, we pause/prorate. For benefits: international coverage varies. Submit the temporary location and we'll route to Benefits to confirm international medical/network coverage and any out-of-country provider rules.

benefits-bot: Note: Redwood's medical plan has limited out-of-country benefits; pre-authorization required for certain services. For 4 months, you may remain on the US plan but must enroll any dependents locally if they require care. Benefits team will DM.

people-ops-global: Logistics: 1) Temporary Location Declaration (Workday) 2) indicate whether company shipping (laptop) or employee takes it 3) travel vs relocation (we treat <=180d as travel/temporary) 4) People Ops will coordinate with Payroll and Legal.

legal: Immigration/tax note: Mexico has a 183-day rule for tax residence; 4 months <183 but close. Also, some municipal rules treat cross-border services differently. We'll review once Workday form is in. If you will invoice or bill local client, flag immediately.

diego: Thanks. One more: can I get a one-time family relocation stipend (to help with short-term lease or airfare)? Policy mentions relocation is for permanent moves. Any exceptions?

ana (People Ops Lead): For temporary caregiving moves we sometimes approve a "short-stay support" one-time payment up to $1,500 under `TEMP_CARE_SUPPORT`. Submit a brief justification on the Workday form and tag People Ops. Approval depends on budget and manager sign-off.

diego: Submitted the form and justification (manager approved). Attaching expected dates. Thanks all :pray:
